turns.shown:
Rijksmuseum Amsterdam opening hours — Answered.
Several pages dated to 2026 say the Rijksmuseum's main building is open every day from 9:00 to 17:00, public holidays included. Those pages are third-party sites. The museum's own pages are held but undated. One of them says the museum is open on Christmas Day 2026 with its regular hours. Only indicated, not established: Some sites also give a last entry time of 16:00, but I found nothing from the museum itself to confirm it. [12] [13] [14] [15] [11] [1] [2] [16] [17]

What I couldn't establish
- Last entry time — Only non-official pages give it, and they disagree (4:30 pm versus 4 pm). The museum's own page doesn't state one.
- Date of the museum's page — The page doesn't state a date for the hours, so I can't give an as-of date. I also didn't find a notice of special closures or changed hours for late October 2026.
- Date of the museum's own opening-hours page — the one search this call returned only third-party pages dated 2026. The museum's pages were still not seen with a date.
- Last admission time — only secondary sites mention 16:00, so I treat it as unconfirmed.
